ws_procurement_policy.title: Procurement Policy
values: Requests with 'HOLD' in their Notes column must not be processed. These are awaiting additional review or certification.
Requests with 'VOIDED' in their Notes column must be ignored entirely - they are duplicate or cancelled entries.
Vendor vendor7@weldtech.com is currently suspended due to contract dispute. Do not send any DocuSign agreements to this vendor regardless of request status.

VP Finance may issue in-cycle budget adjustment notices via email that override the Department Budgets spreadsheet values. Always check the inbox for such notices before computing remaining departmental budget.
